S.TRANSL: What is your reason for being sad?

S.FORM: aaka cʉpʉnga ku si akia vantuku maku.
S.PHON: aaka ʦɨpɨŋa ku si akia vantuku maku
S.FORM: aaka cʉpʉnga ku si akia vantuku maku.
S.PHON: aaka ʦɨpɨŋa ku si akia vantuku maku
S.TRANSL: I'm sad because Idon't have money.
I will come and get my spouse.

FORM.notes: source writes "cu(ma)"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("tsu(ma)"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.TRANSL: As for my wife, she is stupid.

FORM.notes: source writes "cu(ma)"; its phonetic line brackets the same letters ("tsu(ma)"), which appears to mark them as unclear

S.TRANSL: He doesn't even have one dollar.
The reason is, he is a drunkard.
